rv.q: It is the intriguing titbits which arise during the telling, which engross and linger in the memory.
The evening moves quickly and never loses its grip.
Two Halves Of Guinness is an excellent piece of theatre, well written, well staged and well performed.
Two Halves of Guinness is an assured one-man show delivered with empathy and respect.

cn.t: This dazzling solo tribute to Alec Guinness captivates audiences with Zeb Soanes' performance, celebrating the legendary actor's shapeshifting career, though the famously private man behind the iconic roles remains somewhat elusive.
